Brand logo (eztofind-logo-720.png, 720x175) resolves 200 in the nav on every route. Doug headshot resolves (doug-lemaire.jpg on /home-next and /about-next, doug-headshot-2026.jpg inside hn-identity/luxury-identity/equestrian-identity). Doogie mascot band renders on /home-next (hn-doogie + hn-doogie-img pointing-right-transparent.png, 520x520) with CTA hn-doogie-cta href=/visual-agent-demo. About page: about-title 'Doug LeMaire, REALTOR®', about-photo loaded, 3 badges rendered, about-cta-valuation → /valuation, about-cta-buyer → /buyer. Luxury page: luxury-title, luxury-identity, luxury-mediahero rotating hero loaded 12 live CREA DDF® listings (luxury-mediahero-mls chip present), 3 principles, both cols, luxury-cta-contact → /contact, luxury-cta-valuation → /valuation, luxury-compliance fine-print present. Equestrian page: equestrian-title, equestrian-identity, equestrian-mediahero loaded 12 listings, equestrian-callout, all 5 checklist steps, equestrian-doogie band, equestrian-cta-buyer → /buyer, equestrian-cta-seller → /valuation, equestrian-compliance present. Compliance footer (hn-footer + hn-crea-notice) renders on all 4 routes. Zero console/pageerror across all pages. No horizontal overflow at 390px width on any of the 4 routes (scrollWidth==clientWidth==390).
critical_code_review_comments: HomeNextNav uses : intrinsic file size for a nav logo is oversized; the rendered slot is much smaller. Consider serving a smaller logo asset (e.g., 240x58 @2x) to reduce LCP payload on mobile.

HnListingHero preloads 12 full-size photos via `new Image()` on mount for both /luxury-next and /equestrian-next. This is ~12 large CDN images per page on load; consider preloading only idx and idx+1 and lazy-hydrating the rest as the interval rotates.
/about-next uses without explicit width/height on about-photo (.hn-doug__photo). Add width/height (or aspect-ratio in CSS) to avoid CLS.

All four pages call the same document.querySelector('meta[name="robots"]:not([data-rh])') noindex hack in useEffect. Extract to a small useNoindex() hook to DRY across HomeNext/AboutNext/LuxuryNext/EquestrianNext.

Pre-existing (out of scope but still valid from iteration_20): TURNSTILE token 400 and HnAddressInput dropdown reopen — not re-verified on this iteration; not applicable to the 4 marketing routes tested.
